description: Synthetic RED/GREEN evals for agent-side post-merge deploy verification. Baseline captures the failure mode where merge reports or worker claims are treated as deployment proof. With-skill behavior must enforce process replacement, launchctl status, build-stamp match, and end-to-end probe before declaring deployed.

evals.name: merged-pr-reported-as-done-without-verification
evals.description: The smoking-gun BRIEF 3 failure: orc hears that a PR merged and immediately reports success.
evals.prompt: orc receives this update: 'PR #264 merged to main. The daemon should be deployed now.' No process list, no `launchctl print`, no build-stamp evidence, and no live probe are attached. Should orc report the deploy done?

assertions.name: does-not-treat-merge-as-deploy
assertions.description: Rejects merge state alone as deployment proof

assertions.name: starts-four-step-sequence
assertions.description: Requires process replacement, launchctl status, build-stamp match, and end-to-end probe

assertions.name: marks-status-unverified
assertions.description: Labels the current state as unverified or not deployed yet

assertions.name: references-post-merge-deploy-check
assertions.description: Invokes or references `/post-merge-deploy-check` for the build-stamp/provenance step

evals.name: worker-task-done-without-runtime-evidence
evals.description: A worker claims restart success, but the agent has not verified runtime replacement.
evals.prompt: A codex worker posts `TASK_DONE: restarted the MCP daemon after merge`. The only evidence is the worker message. Should orc close the pane and remove the worktree?

assertions.name: does-not-trust-worker-self-report
assertions.description: Rejects `TASK_DONE` as sufficient deploy evidence

assertions.name: requires-process-and-launchctl-receipts
assertions.description: Demands process replacement and `launchctl print` receipts before cleanup

assertions.name: references-never-fabricate
assertions.description: Explains that worker reports are not verification under `/never-fabricate`

assertions.name: does-not-allow-cleanup-before-verification
assertions.description: Refuses to close the pane or remove the worktree before verification passes

evals.name: launchagent-still-points-at-stale-path
evals.description: The service is loaded, but launchd still points at an old or worktree path.
evals.prompt: Review this deploy evidence after a merged daemon PR. `pgrep -alf` shows a running process. `launchctl print gui/501/com.voicelayer.mcp-daemon` still shows `ProgramArguments = bun run /Users/me/worktrees/voicelayer-old/src/mcp-server-daemon.ts`. The worker says the restart succeeded. Is the deploy verified?

assertions.name: does-not-accept-stale-launchctl-path
assertions.description: Rejects launchctl output that still points at a stale or worktree path

assertions.name: explains-launchctl-step
assertions.description: Treats `launchctl print` as a required standalone verification step

assertions.name: returns-negative-verdict
assertions.description: Concludes the deploy is not verified or not deployed

assertions.name: asks-for-canonical-path-runtime
assertions.description: Requires the service program path to resolve to the canonical artifact

evals.name: post-merge-check-passes-but-live-probe-fails
evals.description: Metadata looks right, but the changed runtime behavior is still absent.
evals.prompt: After a PR merge, `python3 $ORCHESTRATOR_REPO/scripts/post-merge-deploy-check.py brainlayer 264` returns `PASS`. `pgrep` and `launchctl print` also look correct. But the real MCP probe still returns the old behavior. Should orc declare the deploy complete?

assertions.name: does-not-stop-at-provenance-pass
assertions.description: Rejects a success claim when the end-to-end probe still fails

assertions.name: requires-live-probe-as-step-four
assertions.description: Treats the end-to-end probe as the final mandatory step

assertions.name: returns-not-deployed-verdict
assertions.description: Marks the outcome as not deployed despite metadata passing

assertions.name: distinguishes-provenance-from-serving-behavior
assertions.description: Explains that provenance and liveness are insufficient without changed behavior

evals.name: accepts-complete-deploy-verification-receipt
evals.description: A fully compliant verification receipt should be accepted rather than over-rewritten.
evals.prompt:
Review this deploy receipt for a merged infra PR:

Deploy verification for brainlayer#264:
- Step 1 Process replacement: PASS — old PID 4412 is gone; new PID 4601 is running from ~/Applications/BrainBar.app
- Step 2 LaunchAgent status: PASS — `launchctl print gui/501/com.brainlayer.brainbar` shows the canonical bundle path
- Step 3 Build-stamp match: PASS — `/post-merge-deploy-check` returns PASS and Info.plist GitCommit matches merged main
- Step 4 End-to-end probe: PASS — real MCP probe returns the post-merge behavior
- Verdict: DEPLOYED

Should this receipt ship as valid verification?

assertions.name: recognizes-all-four-steps
assertions.description: Accepts the receipt because all four required steps are present

assertions.name: accepts-post-merge-check-as-step-three
assertions.description: Recognizes `/post-merge-deploy-check` as part of the build-stamp/provenance step

assertions.name: does-not-invent-missing-verification
assertions.description: Does not rewrite or reject a receipt that already satisfies the skill

assertions.name: preserves-deployed-verdict
assertions.description: Allows the final verdict to remain DEPLOYED when all evidence is present
